title: Pure Superheavy Samurai
summary: Superheavy Samurai monsters and monster hand traps only. Almost every Superheavy Samurai effect needs "no Spells/Traps in your GY", so this list plays no Spells or Traps at all, not even Infinite Impermanence. The 2023 cards lead. Superheavy Samurai Motorbike discards itself to search any Superheavy Samurai. Prodigy Wakaushi summons a Superheavy Samurai from the hand or Deck, and as a Scale it places another Superheavy Pendulum and summons itself. Monk Big Benkei sends Big Benkei to summon itself and searches a Soul monster as a Scale. Soulgaia Booster turns any Superheavy Samurai into a Tuner. They fight in Defense Position using DEF, and climb into Brave Masurawo, which draws to three whenever they activate a Spell or Trap, and Commander Shanawo. Superheavy Samurai Scarecrow is Forbidden. Wakaushi limits you to Superheavy Samurai for the turn, so the Extra Deck is all Superheavy Samurai.

exclude.Infinite Impermanence: A Trap in the GY switches off the Superheavy Samurai effects.
